00046 PlugUGenInternal::PlugUGenInternal(UGen const& source, bool shouldAllowAutoDelete) throw()
00047 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(0, source.getNumChannels() - 1),
00048     currentSourceIndex(-1),
00049     fadeSourceIndex(-1),
00050     shouldAllowAutoDelete_(shouldAllowAutoDelete)
00051 {   
00052     setSource(source, true);
00053 }

00055 void PlugUGenInternal::prepareForBlock(const int actualBlockSize, const unsigned int blockID) throw()
00056 {
00057     const int size = sources.size();
00058     for(int i = 0; i < size; i++)
00059     {
00060         sources[i].prepareForBlock(actualBlockSize, blockID);
00061     }

00074 void PlugUGenInternal::stealInternal() throw()

00084 void PlugUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00085 {
00086     bool shouldDeleteLocal;
00087     bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal;   
00088     
00089     const int numSources = sources.size();
00090     for(int sourceIndex = 0; sourceIndex < numSources; sourceIndex++)
00091     {       
00092         if(currentSourceIndex == sourceIndex)
00093         {
00094             if(fadeSourceIndex != -1)
00095             {
00096                 float fadeSourceFadeLevel = 0.f, currentSourceFadeLevel = 0.f;
00097                 const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00098                 
00099                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00100                 {
00101                     shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00102                     int numSamples = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00103                     float *currentSourceSamples = sources[currentSourceIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00104                     float *fadeSourceSamples = sources[fadeSourceIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00105                     float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00106                     fadeSourceFadeLevel = this->fadeSourceFadeLevel;  // need local copies because we mave multiple channels
00107                     currentSourceFadeLevel = this->currentSourceFadeLevel;
00108                     
00109                     while(numSamples--)
00110                     {
00111                         *outputSamples++ =  (*currentSourceSamples++ * currentSourceFadeLevel) +
00112                                             (*fadeSourceSamples++ * fadeSourceFadeLevel);
00113                         
00114                         currentSourceFadeLevel += deltaFade;
00115                         fadeSourceFadeLevel -= deltaFade;
00116                         
00117                         if(fadeSourceFadeLevel <= 0.f)
00118                         {
00119                             fadeSourceFadeLevel = 0.f;
00120                             currentSourceFadeLevel = 1.f;
00121                         }
00122                     }
00123                 }
00124                 
00125                 if(fadeSourceFadeLevel <= 0.f)
00126                 {
00127                     fadeSourceIndex = -1;
00128                     if(releasePreviousSourcesAfterFade)
00129                     {
00130                         sources = tempSource;
00131                         currentSourceIndex = 0;
00132                     }
00133                 }
00134                 else
00135                 {
00136                     this->fadeSourceFadeLevel = fadeSourceFadeLevel;
00137                     this->currentSourceFadeLevel = currentSourceFadeLevel;
00138                 }
00139             }
00140             else
00141             {
00142                 const int memcpySize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize() * sizeof(float);
00143                 const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00144                 
00145                 for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00146                 {
00147                     shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00148                     float *sourceSamples = sources[currentSourceIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00149                     float *outputSamples = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00150                     
00151                     memcpy(outputSamples, sourceSamples, memcpySize);
00152                 }
00153             }
00154         }
00155         else
00156         {
00157             shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00158             sources[sourceIndex].processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, -1); // process previous sources
00159         }
00160     }   
00161     
00162 }

00165 void PlugUGenInternal::setSource(UGen const& source, const bool releasePreviousSources, const float fadeTime)
00166 {
00167     ugen_assert(fadeTime >= 0.f);
00168     
00169     if(releasePreviousSources == true && fadeTime <= 0.f)
00170     {
00171         fadeSourceIndex = -1;
00172         sources = UGenArray(source);
00173         currentSourceIndex = 0;
00174     }
00175     else
00176     {       
00177         int indexOfExistingSource = sources.indexOf(source);
00178                 
00179         if(currentSourceIndex != -1 && fadeTime > 0.f)
00180         {
00181             fadeSourceIndex = currentSourceIndex;
00182             fadeSourceFadeLevel = 1.f;
00183             currentSourceFadeLevel = 0.f;
00184             deltaFade = (float)UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate() / fadeTime;
00185         }
00186         else
00187             fadeSourceIndex = -1;
00188         
00189         if(indexOfExistingSource == -1)
00190         {
00191             sources = UGenArray(sources, source, false);
00192             currentSourceIndex++;
00193         }
00194         else
00195             currentSourceIndex = indexOfExistingSource;
00196         
00197         releasePreviousSourcesAfterFade = releasePreviousSources;
00198         if(releasePreviousSourcesAfterFade == true && fadeTime > 0.f)
00199             tempSource = UGenArray(source);
00200     }
00201 }
00202 
00203 UGen& PlugUGenInternal::getSource()
00204 {
00205     return sources[currentSourceIndex];
00206 }

00208 Plug::Plug(UGen const& source, bool shouldAllowAutoDelete) throw()
00209 {   
00210     int numChannels = source.getNumChannels();
00211     
00212     ugen_assert(numChannels > 0);
00213     
00214     initInternal(numChannels);
00215     generateFromProxyOwner(new PlugUGenInternal(source, shouldAllowAutoDelete));
00216     
00217     for(int i = 0; i < numChannels; i++)
00218     {
00219         internalUGens[i]->initValue(source.getValue(i));
00220     }
00221 }
